description: Read the Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) anchoring state of the ledger's pending Merkle roots, or — only when action:'anchor' is passed explicitly — request that pending roots be aggregated and submitted to the OTS calendars. Defaults to 'status' (read-only) so a routine call never triggers a batch write. An anchor becomes confirmed only when a real Bitcoin block is found.

action.description: 'status' reads the anchor state (default); 'anchor' explicitly requests anchoring of pending roots

name: anchor
title: Bitcoin anchoring status / request
